description: User explicitly requests adapter owns splitting, full attachment list passed unchanged. Generic bridge projects metadata.delivery_report to per-message receipts. DeliveryConfirmation forwards each confirmed receipt; Engine stores continuation as its own canonical assistant/history entry. Reuse existing delivery and history APIs, local projection only; no provider rules in ZAQ. Replace recently added too-many-files rejection test with approved required 15-file success behavior. Verify separate history, replay and partial delivery.
title: Consume adapter-owned multi-post delivery reports
